verdict.rationale: This skill pack produces AI-generated insights from the user's own code and issues: a skill finds modules worth refactoring as a visual report, another reviews a diff against your standards and spec, and triage categorises and verifies raw issues into agent-ready briefs. These insights are delivered through a third-party host agent (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) rather than inside the product itself, and the evidence is one-line marketing descriptions. Missing for 10: native in-product insight surface independent of a host agent, detailed docs on what the refactoring report or review output contains, insights over data beyond code and issues, independent or hands-on corroboration.
